reuse.why: Threads the flag through the existing shared ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked guard used by all six link handlers, but writes its own unlink update instead of extracting/reusing the field reset in unlinkAccount.

duplication.why: The db.updateAccount block that nulls account_id, bank, balances, sync source and status is a verbatim copy of unlinkAccount's.

placement.why: The takeover lives in the shared link guard in accounts/app.ts, which is the right layer, but it makes a function named ensure…NotLinked perform the unlink mutation.

scope.why: Only the flag, its threading and a test; the goCardless call is left as an unformatted long line.

maintainability.why: If the unlink action later clears more fields, this copy will silently diverge, and the guard's name no longer describes what it does.

bypasses_abstraction.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked in accounts/app.ts re-does unlinkAccount's db.updateAccount field reset instead of sharing it

disguised_duplication.where: The unlink field reset is copied verbatim, not disguised
